build.name: single-file g++ -std=c++20 (eliza.cpp embeds the 1966 DOCTOR script + tests)
build.cmd: g++ -std=c++20 -O2 -o eliza src/eliza.cpp 2>&1 | head -5; test -x ./eliza && echo built

runs.name: reproduce the opening of Weizenbaum's 1966 CACM conversation, incl. pronoun reflection (my->YOUR, me->YOU)
runs.cmd:
printf 'Men are all alike.
They are always bugging us about something or other.
Well, my boyfriend made me come here.
' | ./eliza --nobanner 2>&1

stdout.text:
HOW DO YOU DO. PLEASE TELL ME YOUR PROBLEM

IN WHAT WAY

CAN YOU THINK OF A SPECIFIC EXAMPLE

YOUR BOYFRIEND MADE YOU COME HERE

runs.name: the embedded self-tests reproduce the documented 1966/1965 conversations at startup (report the 'test failed' count -- expect 0 -- and that the greeting is reached)
runs.cmd: printf '' | ./eliza 2>&1 > /tmp/o; echo "test_failed_lines=$(grep -ci 'test failed' /tmp/o)"; echo "greeting=$(grep -c 'PLEASE TELL ME YOUR PROBLEM' /tmp/o)"

runs.name: a turn whose words hit no DOCTOR keyword falls through to a scripted deflection (the failure mode)

stdout.text: I AM NOT SURE I UNDERSTAND YOU FULLY
